stories.title: Distance Field Contract for Chat Messages
stories.description: Define and enforce frontend contract for provider distance fields (distance_miles:number, distance_text:string) within structured chat payload segments, ensuring compatibility with markdown-rendered MessageBubble and future extensibility.

stories.title: Distance Formatting Logic
stories.description: Implement client-side formatting logic to normalize backend distance values into consistent display strings (rounded miles, unit standardization, null-safe fallback, and '<1 mi' handling).

stories.title: Render Distance in MessageBubble UI
stories.description: Enhance MessageBubble to render formatted distance inline with provider entries (near name/address) without breaking markdown rendering, spacing, responsiveness, or accessibility (ARIA labels, screen reader clarity).

stories.title: End-to-End Distance Data Integration
stories.description: Ensure distance values from MAINT-DIST propagate through find_care_facade and tool_router into chat response payloads, matching the frontend contract exactly with no schema drift.

stories.title: Distance Display Test Coverage
stories.description: Add unit and UI tests validating distance formatting, rendering in MessageBubble, contract compliance, edge cases, and graceful handling of missing or malformed values.
